purpose: Replace four vector learning illustrations with AI-generated photorealistic reference images.

prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a landscape photograph-style image for a Korean grade 4 science learning web app, replacing a flat vector drawing. Produce one single natural-looking photographic scene, landscape 3:2, realistic colors, natural lighting and visible real surface textures. Clear central subject that still reads well in a small website card and remains visible in a wide center crop. No typography, no captions, no watermarks, no borders, no diptych, no diagram, no inset, no drawn outlines, no illustration, no toy-like 3D rendering. This illustrates ordinary life before students make predictions; do not portray a disaster or an exaggerated climate change outcome. Scene: a normal South Korean elementary school playground, with two Korean children about nine or ten years old, in comfortable short-sleeved everyday PE clothes, naturally passing a soft soccer ball. Framed as a candid school-life editorial photograph from a respectful medium distance. Plain school building and a few green trees softly out of focus behind them. The children are full-body in the middle of the frame, anatomically correct, natural expressions, not posed for advertising. A clear mild warm day, realistic afternoon daylight, ordinary schoolyard with sandy ground. Do not use logos, name badges, readable signs or text.
